problem_text:
A logistics company needs to distribute its total shipping volume across 17 regional hubs to maximize overall delivery efficiency.  
The performance metrics for each hub are as follows:  
* Hub A: efficiency score 0.145, congestion index 0.205, capacity limits [0.009, 0.631]  
* Hub B: efficiency score 0.136, congestion index 0.112, capacity limits [0.061, 0.696]  
* Hub C: efficiency score 0.020, congestion index 0.246, capacity limits [0.030, 0.639]  
* Hub D: efficiency score 0.106, congestion index 0.250, capacity limits [0.072, 0.709]  
* Hub E: efficiency score 0.182, congestion index 0.114, capacity limits [0.023, 0.639]  
* Hub F: efficiency score 0.141, congestion index 0.061, capacity limits [0.049, 0.339]  
* Hub G: efficiency score 0.094, congestion index 0.233, capacity limits [0.036, 0.377]  
* Hub H: efficiency score 0.181, congestion index 0.212, capacity limits [0.028, 0.339]  
* Hub I: efficiency score 0.147, congestion index 0.012, capacity limits [0.090, 0.456]  
* Hub J: efficiency score 0.157, congestion index 0.144, capacity limits [0.071, 0.642]  
* Hub K: efficiency score 0.117, congestion index 0.282, capacity limits [0.021, 0.437]  
* Hub L: efficiency score 0.162, congestion index 0.139, capacity limits [0.020, 0.614]  
* Hub M: efficiency score 0.137, congestion index 0.074, capacity limits [0.082, 0.769]  
* Hub N: efficiency score 0.034, congestion index 0.016, capacity limits [0.040, 0.415]  
* Hub O: efficiency score 0.026, congestion index 0.092, capacity limits [0.087, 0.707]  
* Hub P: efficiency score 0.170, congestion index 0.277, capacity limits [0.057, 0.895]  
* Hub Q: efficiency score 0.141, congestion index 0.114, capacity limits [0.049, 0.716]  

Each hub must handle a portion of the total shipping volume within its specified capacity limits, and the sum of all volume shares must equal one. To maintain operational flexibility, the company requires that the group of high-priority hubs, represented by the set L = {A, B, F, G, H, I, O, P}, collectively handle at least 0.418 of the total volume.  
At the same time, the overall system congestion, measured by a composite congestion index, must not exceed 0.197, and the total efficiency score of the distribution plan must be no less than 0.087.  
Determine the optimal volume allocation across hubs that maximizes total efficiency while satisfying all constraints.
